depreciation.title: Fixed Asset Depreciation Schedule in Excel: 2,599 Over 36 Months = 72.19 a Month #Shorts
depreciation.description:
One row per asset in the register — in-service date, cost, salvage, life — and the schedule computes each month. FA-0001: cost 2,599 over 36 months = 72.19. KDesk Fixed Asset workbook.
Full walkthrough + workbook: https://kdeskaccounting.com/templates/fixed-assets/
Free version: https://kdeskaccounting.gumroad.com/l/fixed-asset-rollforward-free

je.title: Monthly Depreciation Journal Entry in Excel — By Category, With Your GL Codes #Shorts
je.description:
GL accounts mapped once per category; December's 1,885.01 of depreciation posts as one credit to accumulated depreciation. From the KDesk Fixed Asset workbook.
Full walkthrough + workbook: https://kdeskaccounting.com/templates/fixed-assets/
Free version: https://kdeskaccounting.gumroad.com/l/fixed-asset-rollforward-free
